title: This $23.99 Find My tracker fits in your wallet like a credit card
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Track your wallet with Apple Find My using the MagTag tracker card, now $23.99 (reg. $59.99).

AirTags work well on keys and bags, but their round shape leaves a bulge in a wallet. MagTag is a tracker card the size of a credit card and just 1.5mm thick, works with Apple’s Find My app, and is on sale for $23.99 (reg. $59.99).

Once you add MagTag to Find My, it reports its location in real time through Apple’s network anywhere in the world. If you leave your wallet behind at a restaurant, your iPhone sends an alert as you walk away. If you lose it somewhere in the house, MagTag can play a loud beep to help you find it.

The flat shape fits a wallet, passport pouch, backpack, or suitcase. A built-in keyring hole lets you hang it on keys, an ID lanyard, or a kid’s bag. One charge lasts up to 5 months, and any Qi wireless charger can recharge it. MagTag is also IP68 waterproof and dustproof and comes with a 90-day manufacturer’s warranty.

Keep your wallet on the map without a lump in your pocket.
